latin.label: Latin Texts
latin.notes: 5,261 books with OCR. Printed Latin — easiest baseline.

german.label: German Texts (incl. Fraktur)
german.notes: 1,851 books. Mix of Fraktur and Roman typefaces.

tibetan.label: Tibetan Buddhist Manuscripts
tibetan.notes: 1,109 books. dbu can + dbu med scripts. EAP/BDRC/IIIF sources.

greek.label: Ancient Greek Texts
greek.notes: 781 books. Aldine and early printed editions.

hebrew.label: Hebrew Texts
hebrew.notes: 187 books. Hebrew + Rashi script. Known failure mode for some models.

bph.label: BPH Manuscripts (Embassy of the Free Mind)
bph.notes: 2,254 books. High-quality scans from Bibliotheca Philosophica Hermetica.

javanese-mss.label: Javanese Kraton Manuscripts (aksara Jawa, handwritten)
javanese-mss.notes: BL Yogyakarta Kraton manuscripts (Babad bedhah, Serat Selarasa) @ 4000px. HIGH OCR risk — the Tibetan analog: unfamiliar handwritten script, must benchmark before scaling. Should route to full Flash, never lite.

javanese-dutch.label: Dutch colonial-era Java scholarship (printed, b-nice)
javanese-dutch.notes: b-nice Pustaka Nusantara (Krom, etc.). Printed Latin baseline — low OCR risk; flash-lite likely fine. Watch transliteration diacritics (ṣ ṛ ḍ ñ).
